title: Light ponding
description: Short heavy rain: stormwater collects in low spots across the area, each depression a quarter full. The river stays within its banks. A static estimate, not a hydraulic model: no flow or velocity.
sources: Mechanism: Melbourne Water, Southbank Precinct Local Floodplain Development Plan (2026).

Stormwater ponding: closed depressions of the ground model, anywhere in the area; the plan describes local stormwater flooding as shallow but widespread across streets, laneways and building interfaces.
Ground: Geoscience Australia 5 m LiDAR digital elevation model (CC BY 4.0).
